results.content: Predictive coding is a foundational theory in neuroscience proposing that the brain is fundamentally a prediction machine, constantly attempting to anticipate incoming sensory inputs and updating internal representations to minimize the difference between expectations and actual observations.
results.title: Introduction to Predictive Coding Networks for Machine Learning

results.content: Abstract:Predictive coding offers a potentially unifying account of cortical function -- postulating that the core function of the brain is to minimize prediction errors with respect to a generative model of the world.
results.title: [2107.12979] Predictive Coding: a Theoretical and Experimental Review
